example_renderings.english:
Tag axioms: every entity is exactly one of user, group, role, resource; contractor entities are users; employee entities are users; suspended entities are users; external entities are groups; restricted entities are groups; privileged entities are roles; temporary entities are roles; confidential entities are resources; public entities are resources; archived entities are resources; nothing is both contractor and employee or both confidential and public.
Permitted change: a "member_of" fact may link a user or group to a group.
Permitted change: a "holds" fact may link a user or group to a role.
Permitted change: an "inherits" fact may link a role to a role.
Permitted change: a "grants" fact may link a role to a resource.
Permitted change: a "sponsored_by" fact may link a user to a group.
Permitted change: an "owns" fact may link a user or group to a resource.
Permitted change: a "delegates_to" fact may link a role to a role or user.
Permitted change: no "inherits" fact may link a source that is not privileged to a destination that is not privileged.
Rule 1: a "holds" fact gives the source the access of the destination, unless the source is restricted or the destination is privileged.
Rule 2: a "delegates_to" fact gives the source the access of the destination, unless the destination is suspended.
Rule 3: a "member_of" fact gives the source the access of the destination.
Rule 4: a "sponsored_by" fact gives the source the access of the destination.
Rule 5: an "inherits" fact gives the source the access of the destination, unless the destination is privileged.
Rule 6: a "grants" fact gives the source the access of the destination when the source is temporary, unless the destination is public.
Claim: under every permitted policy, no suspended entity can reach a confidential entity by a chain of one or more rule steps.
